title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover race condition
author: Ava Chen
description: Background: We observed regional failover thrashing during a production incident where concurrent policy reconfigurations and rapid client connection churn caused the SLO enforcer to trigger circuit-breakers and regional failovers repeatedly. Root cause: a race in the SLO enforcer's region state machine - concurrent config updates and async metrics flushes could cause duplicate state transitions and incorrectly reset hysteresis/backoff timers, leading to repeated load-shedding and failover.
commits: a1f3d2f: Fix race in regional failover state machine; add epoch checks to ignore stale transitions
b4c5d6e: Add mutex around enforcer region state transitions and a non-blocking fast-path for common reads
c7d8e9f: Add integration test that simulates concurrent policy updates and connection churn
d9e0f1a: Telemetry: new metrics slo_enforcer.region_transition_count and slo_enforcer.transition_epoch_mismatch
e2f3a4b: Update k8s deployment to increase env var for controlled backoff; docs: ops troubleshooting
review_comments: Marcus Li: The epoch check looks good. Concern: the mutex might become a hot path for high-frequency requests - can we add a non-blocking fast-path to avoid contending on reads?

Ava Chen (author): Added a fast-path in this patchset: reads use an atomic snapshot of the region state and only take the mutex for transitions. Benchmarks show <1% p50 latency impact under our internal load test.
Priya Nair: Can you add a regression integration test that simulates a burst of concurrent config updates + client churn? This is the scenario that surfaced this issue.
Ava Chen (author): Added regional_failover_test.go which replays the production incident sequence and asserts no more than one region transition per configured hysteresis window. Test included in CI.
Ethan Brooks: Verified metrics and logs look sane in staging; approving after CI green.
Marcus Li: 👍 approving and will squash-merge once the final CI run completes.
merge_outcome: Merged by Marcus Li via squash after green CI
release_notes: Fix race condition in SLO enforcer region state machine that could cause failover thrashing; adds epoch checks, mutex protection for transitions, and regression tests. Improves stability of regional failover and load-shedding behavior.
